observations: Stainless steel gas cooker with a glass top.
Four gas burners on the top surface.
Five control knobs on the front panel.
A built-in oven with a wire rack inside.
A separate drawer unit below the oven.
The oven door is open in photos 0 and 2.
The glass top is reflective and shows reflections of the surroundings.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'HITHE TECHNOLOGIES' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a clean exterior with no visible scratches or dents.
No photo shows the burners lit or the oven heating.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Burners may be faulty or leaking gas.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or have a broken thermostat.
risks.proof: A video of the oven heating up with a thermometer inside.

risks.risk: The glass top may have micro-cracks or scratches not visible in the reflection.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the glass surface with a ruler or magnifying glass.
risks.if_unproven: as having a scratched glass top

risks.risk: The oven door seal may be damaged or leaking.
risks.proof: A video of the oven door being closed while the oven is on.
risks.if_unproven: as having a faulty door seal

proof_requests: Video of all four burners lit and working.
Video of the oven heating up.
Close-up photo of the glass top to check for scratches.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the back or side of the unit.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
